author: devantefingle
quote:
If you told me the game was made by a team who has never played GTA, I'd believe you in an instant. 2 billion, 13 years, the most anticipated game of all time, paid 99 percent critic reviews, and what do you get?

A clunky, 20-30 fps 100 dollar mediocre dating sim with good graphics and rdr2 controls. Minus the storyline and character writing. Everything is genuinely so sanitized I can't even put it in the same genre as every other GTA. Both MCs are hateable with absolutely zero redeeming qualities. You have zero player freedom. All the people that made GTA the biggest game in the world are gone now, replaced by Indians and women. Enjoy your slop. What do you expect when the game is made by people who hate you, who hate the older GTAs too? 

And ask yourself, what made GTA fun? Is it assembling chairs and getting groceries and buying a necklace for a cheating child-neglecting jailbird that treats you like a joke? Is it playing as a blank slate that acts lobotomized and is a soulless golem? Food for thought.
